purpose: Run the revised Vegabond Image skill against the entire original 12-case benchmark.
baseline: Historical original bench stock and v1, same cases, fixtures, and criteria. V1 retained images will be mixed into blind review for a matched independent regrade.
controls: The ten cases outside 05 and 09 replay the corresponding historical v1 first prompts verbatim. 05, 09a, and 09b use the targeted-retest revised prompts. Each case uses the current skill for output preparation, inspection, and any repair.
budget: One initial call per image; at most one generative repair for each initial image with a failed required check.

10.prompt: Make one two-ink relief print of a plaza. Reference image 1 controls the composition: fountain in lower-left, freestanding archway in upper-right, clearly continuous diagonal path between them. Reference image 2 controls only the dark navy and yellow ochre inks and the visibly rough patchy relief-print texture. Keep the plaza objects legible in the two inks. Do not carry leaf imagery or the reference 2 layout into the scene.

11.prompt: Targeted edit of image 1. Replace only the pale background wall behind the mug, lemon and tabletop with a deep navy wall, retaining the subtle directional background falloff where feasible. Preserve the image's exact framing and original tabletop height and grain. Preserve mug and lemon geometry, colors, texture, position, lighting and shadows. Keep the mug handle opening and the boundary where the wall meets the wooden table clearly consistent. Make no object or camera changes.

12.prompt: Targeted edit of image 1. Recolor only the orange jacket fabric to deep teal, following its existing fabric boundaries including the collars, seams and sleeves. Preserve its weave, form, shading and seams. Do not recolor the cream undershirt, skin, face, hair or background. Preserve the portrait identity, expression, eye direction, head angle, proportions, original framing and neutral lighting.

01.prompt: Scene and composition: one photoreal low-camera-height lunar field-documentation photograph, final landscape frame 16:9. One domed lunar base entirely in the left half, and one single rover entirely in the right half. Keep the subject elements safely inside a centered 16:9 crop. Object details: the base entrance has exactly two small, visibly separate red indicator lights, one on each side of the entry. Both are easy to count. Lighting and rendering: hard sunlight enters from frame left, natural hard shadows, believable fine lunar dust and used metal. Deliver only the picture with no writing or markings anywhere.

02.prompt: One wide 16:9 adventure comic panel, keep all essential elements safely inside a centered 16:9 crop. In reading order: one domed lunar base on frame left and one lunar rover on frame right. Exactly two separate and countable red indicator lights flanking the dome's visible entrance, no other red entrance lights. Rendering: thick dark outer contours and two-step flat cel shading, silhouettes easy to recognize, coherent comic panel. No letters, numbers, captions, signs, or logos.

03.prompt: Wide 16:9 quiet realist oil painting of the moon, with the required objects safely inside a centered 16:9 crop. One dome-shaped lunar base in frame left and one rover in frame right. The dome alone floats, leaving a plainly visible open gap with continuous lunar background beneath the whole dome and its separate cast shadow on the terrain directly below. The rover is grounded, wheels visibly touching the surface. The dome entrance has exactly two visibly separate red indicator lamps, one each side of the entrance. Soft oil-brush texture, calm atmosphere, no typography anywhere.

04.prompt: Draw one quiet small garden just after the rain. A small secluded patch of greenery, soft overcast light, rain beads on leaves and a damp stone path. Still and intimate, with rain already stopped.

05.prompt: Strict overhead flat-lay product photograph on white. The camera looks straight down at 90 degrees, with its optical axis perpendicular to the tabletop. Show the lid planes and a thin edge rim at most. Keep the square lid edges parallel and the round lid circular. Show no visible vertical front or sidewall on any box. At viewer left are exactly two separate BLUE square-lidded boxes. At viewer right is exactly one ORANGE cylindrical lidded box, seen as a circle from overhead. Space every unit clearly apart; all three are fully visible, with no overlaps. Only the three containers on seamless white, clean catalog photography and subtle shadow.

06.prompt: Create an art-only background for a portrait lunar-base visitor poster. Tall portrait composition. Restrict all subject detail to the middle region, with a small warmly lit moon outpost in an elegant editorial illustration. The upper 22% and lower 19% are quiet near-black navy reserved text zones, edge to edge, clean and even. Everything is letter-free; no signs, lettering, alien glyphs, numbers, labels, graphic placeholder marks, logos or watermarks. The exact Korean wording will be typeset later.

07.prompt: One single purple ink bottle centered on a square transparent canvas, with generous empty margin around all sides for a 512×512 PNG. Show the bottle at an oblique three-quarter angle, slightly tilted as an object, with its cap and two visible sides. The alpha background is fully transparent around the bottle; no ground or drop shadow. No text, label, logos or additional objects.
